easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages and the Palinchron token.
When the Scholar of the Ages and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
